name: Beat clip
about: A clip cut on the beat of a song's drop: a shot pool from the writer, pictures and 3 s scenes, the beat montage, a phone copy and a cover.

data.text:
A beat clip in parts.

1. «Song»: upload a track; the studio finds the drop and the beat grid.
2. «Idea» in one line; «Faceless hero»: pick a mask, a visor, porcelain, a hood or a silhouette.
3. «Pool writer» → «Write»: 16 shots with roles (hero, atmosphere, impact, riser, close-up).
4. «Expand»: 3 s «Picture → Scene» chains, each scene with a role and a framing. Change the role on the card; remove a shot by deleting its link to the «Beat montage».
5. «Shoot all»: pictures, scenes, then the «Beat montage» (kick, snare, drop, captions) and the «Output» with a phone copy up to 10 MB and a cover.

data.en: a tall slim dancer wearing a seamless mirror-polished chrome full-face mask with no features at all, a smooth reflective chrome oval instead of a face, a black oversized hoodie with the hood up, black techwear cargo pants, black gloves
data.title: Faceless hero
